# Alfred.report

> Your domain. Your Alfred. One wake. The report comes back.

Alfred is a voice-first AI Chief of Staff on Cloudflare Workers. You speak once. Closed work comes back. You stay out of the middle.

## Product surfaces (sitemap)

- Home: https://alfred.report/
- Privacy: https://alfred.report/privacy
- Terms: https://alfred.report/terms
- Go Max Al!: https://alfred.report/go-max
- Login: https://alfred.report/login
- Signup: https://alfred.report/signup

Setup is automatic after signup — there is no /setup page.

## Core

- Voice brief: you wake Alfred; Alfred delivers the status — no fluff, no “sir, ready?”
- Durable missions with budgets and evidence gates
- Multi-tenant isolation (your domain, your Alfred)
- Operator path: ORAL

## alfred-pi (local harness)

- Landing: https://alfred.report/
- Go Max Al!: https://alfred.report/go-max
- Login: https://alfred.report/login
- Install (Unix): `curl -fsSL https://alfred.report/install.sh | sh`
- Package: `npm|pnpm|bun add -g @openroyleal/alfred-pi`

CLI: `install alfred report`, `alfred report`, `alfred report update`, `alfred report <slug>`, `/login`.

### LLM ladder (via alfred-ai-gateway)

1. Workers AI free neurons first
2. MIMO flash / pro for easy work
3. Grok for hard smarts while available
